script: When will the new printers be delivered?

questions.exp: 'When' asks for a time, and only "Sometime on Thursday morning" gives one.

script: Who's leading the training session this afternoon?
A. It lasts about two hours.
B. In the large meeting room.
C. Ms Patel from Human Resources.

questions.exp: 'Who' asks for a person, so the answer names Ms Patel.

script: Should we book the train or drive to the client's office?
A. I'd rather take the train.
B. We booked it last week.
C. The client was very happy.

questions.exp: It is an either/or question; the best response chooses one option (the train).

script: Haven't the boxes for the move arrived yet?
A. Yes, I moved there in May.
B. A box of pens, please.
C. They're coming tomorrow, I'm told.

questions.exp: The answer explains the boxes are coming tomorrow. "A box of pens" repeats 'box' as a trap.
opts: Yes, I moved there in May.

script: I can't find the key to the storage room.
A. Try asking the security desk.
B. The store opens at nine.

questions.exp: The speaker states a problem; suggesting the security desk offers a solution. 'Store' and 'key decision' are sound-alike traps.

script: How much will the new desks cost?
A. About two hundred euros each.

questions.exp: 'How much' asks for a price: about two hundred euros each.

script: Hi Tom, have you finished packing your files for the office move on Friday?
Almost. But I'm worried the moving company won't take the filing cabinets. They said they only move sealed boxes.
Really? Then we'd better empty the cabinets and put everything in boxes. I'll ask facilities for twenty more.
Thanks. Also, do you know where our team will sit in the new building?
Yes, the floor plan was e-mailed this morning. We're on the fifth floor, next to the kitchen.
Great. I'll print a copy so everyone knows on Monday.

questions.q: What is the man worried about?
opts: The movers will not carry the cabinets.
The new office is too small.
questions.exp: He says the company 'only move sealed boxes', so they might not take the filing cabinets.

questions.q: What will the woman request?
questions.exp: 'I'll ask facilities for twenty more' — more boxes.

questions.q: What does the man say he will do?
questions.exp: 'I'll print a copy' of the floor plan.

script: Good morning, City Office Supplies. How can I help you?
Hello, I ordered fifty chairs last week, order number 4471, but only thirty arrived this morning.
I'm sorry about that. Let me check... Yes, the other twenty were sent from our second warehouse, so they'll come separately.
When can I expect them? Our new office opens on Monday.
They're scheduled for Saturday. And because of the inconvenience, we'll take ten percent off your invoice.
That's very kind. Saturday works, as long as someone calls before the delivery.

questions.q: Why is the woman calling?
questions.exp: Only thirty of fifty chairs arrived.

questions.q: Why did part of the order arrive later?
opts: It was sent from another warehouse.
questions.exp: 'The other twenty were sent from our second warehouse.'

questions.q: What does the man offer?
questions.exp: 'We'll take ten percent off your invoice.'

script: Good morning, everyone. As you know, we move into the Harbour Street building this Friday.
On Thursday, please take home any personal items from your desk. Anything left behind may be thrown away.
The IT team will disconnect all computers at four p.m. on Thursday, so save your work before then.
On Monday, you'll receive a new security card at the reception desk. You won't be able to use the lifts without it.
If you have questions, contact Daniel in facilities. Thank you.

questions.q: What is the talk mainly about?
questions.exp: The speaker explains what will happen before and after the move.

questions.q: What should listeners do before four p.m. on Thursday?
questions.exp: The computers will be disconnected at four, 'so save your work before then'.

questions.q: Why will listeners need a security card?
questions.exp: 'You won't be able to use the lifts without it.'

script: You're listening to Business Today on Radio Dublin.
Northway Bank announced yesterday that it will open twelve new branches next year, mostly in smaller towns.
The bank says that many customers still prefer to speak to staff in person, especially when applying for loans.
The expansion will create around three hundred jobs. Applications open on the bank's website next month.
After the break, we'll look at this week's property prices.

questions.q: What did Northway Bank announce?
opts: It has a new chief executive.
questions.exp: It 'will open twelve new branches next year'.

questions.q: According to the speaker, why do some customers visit branches?
opts: To speak to staff in person
questions.exp: 'Many customers still prefer to speak to staff in person.'

questions.q: What will listeners hear next?
questions.exp: 'After the break, we'll look at this week's property prices.'

questions.q: All employees must ______ their security cards at the front desk on Monday.
questions.exp: After 'must' we need the base verb: collect.

questions.q: The new office is ______ larger than the old one, so each team will have its own meeting room.
questions.exp: An adverb modifies the comparative 'larger'.

questions.q: Please send the signed contract to Ms Byrne ______ Friday at the latest.
questions.exp: 'By' + deadline: no later than Friday.

questions.q: The marketing team, ______ manager joined last month, has already met its targets.
questions.exp: 'Whose' shows possession: the team's manager.

questions.q: Customers who ______ before 31 May will receive a free gift.
questions.exp: Plural subject 'customers who' takes 'register'.

questions.q: Due to the heavy rain, the outdoor event has been ______ until next Saturday.
questions.exp: An event is 'postponed' (moved later) until a new date.

questions.q: Mr Kelly will be out of the office this week; ______, please contact his assistant.
questions.exp: 'Therefore' shows the result: because he's away, contact the assistant.

questions.q: The survey results were ______ positive, with 92% of guests rating their stay as excellent.
questions.exp: An adverb is needed before the adjective 'positive'.

reading.title: E-mail
text: From Monday, staff parking at our new building will be located in the underground car park. Each employee ___1___ one parking space, which can be booked through the staff website.
Spaces are limited, ___2___ we encourage everyone to cycle or use public transport where possible. ___3___
If you have any problems booking a space, please ___4___ the facilities team at extension 210.

questions.q: Blank 1
questions.exp: Future passive: each employee will be allowed one space from Monday.

questions.q: Blank 2
questions.exp: 'So' introduces the result of limited spaces.

questions.q: Blank 3
opts: The cafeteria will serve hot meals every day.
Thank you for attending the meeting.
Secure bicycle racks are available near the main entrance.
Our previous office was in the city centre.
questions.exp: This sentence continues the idea of cycling, so it fits best.

questions.q: Blank 4
questions.exp: After 'please' we use the base verb.

texts.title: Harbour Street Building — Opening Week
body: The staff cafeteria on the ground floor will open on Tuesday, 4 November, one day after staff move in.
On Monday, free sandwiches and coffee will be available in the fifth-floor kitchen from 12:00 to 2:00.
The building's gym will open the following week. Membership is free for all employees, but you must register at reception.

questions.q: When will the cafeteria open?
opts: On the day staff move in
questions.exp: It opens on Tuesday, 'one day after staff move in'.

questions.q: What will be provided on Monday?
questions.exp: Free sandwiches and coffee at lunchtime.

questions.q: What must employees do to use the gym?
questions.exp: 'You must register at reception.'

texts.title: QuickMove Office Relocation
body: Moving offices? QuickMove has helped more than 500 Irish businesses relocate since 2012.
We pack, transport and set up furniture and IT equipment, usually over a single weekend, so your business keeps working.
Book before 30 November and receive free storage for one month. Call 01 555 0190 for a free quote.

questions.q: What is suggested about QuickMove?
opts: It often finishes moves over a weekend.
questions.exp: 'Usually over a single weekend.'

questions.q: What do customers receive if they book before 30 November?
questions.exp: 'Free storage for one month.'

questions.q: The word 'quote' in the last sentence is closest in meaning to
questions.exp: A 'quote' here is a statement of how much the service will cost.

texts.title: From: Aoife Burke · To: Team leaders · Subject: Welcome tours
body: Hi all, to help everyone settle in, we will run short welcome tours of the Harbour Street building next week. Each tour takes about 30 minutes.
Please choose one time for your team and reply by Thursday. Note that the Wednesday tours are only in the morning because of the board meeting.

texts.title: Welcome tours
body: Wednesday — 09:30, 11:00
Thursday — 14:00, 16:00

questions.q: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
opts: To ask team leaders to choose a tour time
To invite team leaders to a board meeting
To announce a new team leader
questions.exp: 'Please choose one time for your team and reply by Thursday.'

questions.q: How long is each tour?
questions.exp: 'Each tour takes about 30 minutes.'

questions.q: Why are there no afternoon tours on Wednesday?
questions.exp: 'Because of the board meeting.'

questions.q: A team leader wants an afternoon tour as late as possible in the week. Which time should she choose?
questions.exp: Thursday is the latest day, and 16:00 is the latest afternoon slot.

script: Where should I leave my suitcase?
A. At the front desk, please.

questions.exp: 'Where' asks for a place: at the front desk.

script: Would you like a window or an aisle seat?
A. I'll take the aisle, thanks.

questions.exp: An either/or question needs a choice (the aisle). "Yes, I would" does not answer it.

script: Why was the meeting moved to Tuesday?
B. Because the director is travelling on Monday.
C. I'll move it for you.

questions.exp: 'Why' asks for a reason: the director is travelling on Monday.
opts: Because the director is travelling on Monday.

script: You've booked the hotel for the sales conference, haven't you?
B. Yes, three nights at the Grand.
C. I'll read the book later.

questions.exp: A tag question; the answer confirms and adds details (three nights at the Grand).
opts: Yes, three nights at the Grand.

script: How long does it take to get to the airport from here?
B. About forty minutes by taxi.

questions.exp: 'How long' asks about time: about forty minutes by taxi.

script: Let's have lunch before the presentation.
B. Good idea — there's a café downstairs.

questions.exp: A suggestion; the best reply agrees and adds a useful detail about the café.
opts: Good idea — there's a café downstairs.

script: Hi, I'm checking in. The reservation is under Martin Doyle.
Welcome, Mr Doyle. I see you've booked a single room for three nights.
That's right. Actually, my colleague is joining me tomorrow. Could I change to a twin room?
Let me see... We have a twin room available from tomorrow, but not tonight. You could move rooms in the morning.
That's fine. Also, is breakfast included?
Yes, breakfast is served from seven to ten in the garden restaurant.

questions.q: Where are the speakers?
questions.exp: He is checking in and booking rooms.

questions.q: Why does the man want to change rooms?
questions.exp: 'My colleague is joining me tomorrow.'

questions.q: When will the man change rooms?
questions.exp: 'You could move rooms in the morning.'

script: Rob, the flight to Berlin on Thursday has been cancelled.
Oh no. Our workshop there starts on Thursday afternoon.
I know. There's a later flight on Wednesday evening, but it's more expensive.
I think it's worth it. If we arrive Wednesday, we can also prepare the room in the morning.
OK, I'll book it now and ask finance to approve the extra cost.
Thanks. I'll tell the hotel we're arriving a day early.

questions.q: What problem does the woman mention?
questions.exp: 'The flight ... has been cancelled.'

questions.q: Why does the man prefer the Wednesday flight?
opts: They can prepare the room before the workshop.
questions.exp: 'We can also prepare the room in the morning.'

questions.q: What will the man do?
questions.exp: 'I'll tell the hotel we're arriving a day early.' The woman will ask finance.

script: Attention, passengers on flight EI 208 to Madrid.
Because of strong winds in Madrid, this flight will now depart at 3:45 instead of 2:15.
We apologise for the delay. Passengers can collect a meal voucher worth ten euros at the information desk.
Boarding will now take place at gate 22, not gate 14. Please check the screens for further updates.

questions.q: What is the reason for the delay?
questions.exp: 'Because of strong winds in Madrid.'

questions.q: What can passengers get at the information desk?
questions.exp: 'A meal voucher worth ten euros.'

questions.q: What has changed besides the time?
questions.exp: Boarding is now at gate 22, not gate 14.

script: Hello, this is a message for Clara Moore. It's Paul from Lakeside Conference Centre.
You asked about room prices for your company's event in March. The main hall holds two hundred people and costs fifteen hundred euros per day.
That includes projectors and microphones. Lunch can be added for eighteen euros per person.
We only have two free dates left in March, so I'd recommend deciding soon. Please call me back on 087 432 1100.

questions.q: Why is the man calling?
opts: To give information about room prices
To invite Ms Moore to a conference
questions.exp: She 'asked about room prices'.

questions.q: What is included in the daily price?
questions.exp: 'That includes projectors and microphones.'

questions.q: Why does the man recommend deciding soon?
opts: The centre will close for repairs.
questions.exp: 'We only have two free dates left in March.'

questions.q: Travel expenses must be ______ within thirty days of the trip.
questions.exp: Passive: expenses must be submitted.

questions.q: The hotel is ______ located near the convention centre.
questions.exp: An adverb modifies 'located'.

questions.q: Ms Lynch has worked in the sales department ______ 2019.
questions.exp: 'Since' + a point in time with the present perfect.

questions.q: Please ______ us know if you need assistance with your booking.
questions.exp: Fixed phrase: let us know.

questions.q: The keynote speech was so ______ that many attendees asked for a copy.
questions.exp: An adjective after 'so ... that'.

questions.q: Neither the manager ______ her assistant was available to sign the form.
questions.exp: 'Neither ... nor'.

questions.q: Flights booked through the company portal are ______ for a full refund up to 24 hours before departure.
questions.exp: 'Eligible for' a refund = allowed to receive it.

questions.q: ______ the train was delayed, the team still arrived on time for the meeting.
questions.exp: 'Although' + a clause shows contrast; 'Despite' needs a noun.

reading.title: Letter
text: Thank you for staying at the Riverside Hotel last week. We hope you ___1___ your visit.
We noticed that you left a black umbrella in Room 312. Our staff have kept it safely at reception. ___2___
If you would prefer us to send it to you, please reply with your postal address. There is no ___3___ for this service.
We look forward to ___4___ you again soon.
Yours sincerely, Mark Doran, Front Office Manager

questions.q: Blank 1
questions.exp: The visit is in the past: 'enjoyed'.

questions.q: Blank 2
opts: You may collect it at any time.
Our restaurant is open until ten.
questions.exp: This sentence follows naturally from the umbrella being kept at reception.

questions.q: Blank 3
questions.exp: 'There is no charge' = it's free.

questions.q: Blank 4
questions.exp: 'Look forward to' is followed by a gerund: welcoming.

texts.title: Greenfield Ltd — Business Travel Rules
body: Employees must book all flights through the company travel portal at least 14 days before departure, unless the trip is urgent.
Economy class must be used for flights under six hours. For longer flights, employees may choose premium economy.
Taxi receipts must be kept and uploaded with the expense claim. Claims without receipts will not be paid.

questions.q: When can an employee book a flight less than 14 days ahead?
questions.exp: 'Unless the trip is urgent.'

questions.q: Who may travel in premium economy?
opts: Employees on flights over six hours
questions.exp: 'For longer flights' (six hours or more).

questions.q: What will happen if an employee does not upload a taxi receipt?
opts: The claim will not be paid.
The claim will be paid later.
questions.exp: 'Claims without receipts will not be paid.'

texts.title: Business travellers return to the rails
body: More business travellers in Ireland are choosing trains over short flights, according to a survey by the Irish Business Travel Association.
Forty percent of respondents said they had taken a train instead of a plane for at least one work trip this year, mostly to save time on security checks.
However, many said that train tickets are still expensive when booked late, and that Wi-Fi on some routes is unreliable.

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
questions.exp: More business travellers choosing trains — a trend.

questions.q: Why do most travellers choose trains, according to the survey?
questions.exp: 'Mostly to save time on security checks.'

questions.q: What complaint is mentioned about trains?
questions.exp: 'Train tickets are still expensive when booked late.'

texts.title: From: Niamh Walsh · To: Billing, Harbour Hotel · Subject: Invoice 5521
body: Hello, I stayed at your hotel from 12 to 14 October for a conference. My invoice shows three nights, but I only stayed two.
Could you please correct the invoice and send it to my company, Corrib Software, rather than to me personally? Thank you.

texts.title: Harbour Hotel — Invoice 5521
body: Guest: Niamh Walsh
Room: Standard double — 3 nights × €140 = €420
Breakfast — 2 × €15 = €30
Total: €450

questions.q: Why did Ms Walsh write the e-mail?
opts: To report an error on an invoice
questions.exp: The invoice shows three nights instead of two.

questions.q: How much was Ms Walsh overcharged for the room?
questions.exp: One extra night at €140.

questions.q: What does Ms Walsh ask the hotel to do?
opts: Send the invoice to her company
questions.exp: 'Send it to my company ... rather than to me.'

questions.q: What will the correct total probably be?
questions.exp: Two nights (€280) plus breakfast (€30) = €310.

script: Has the new catalogue been printed?
A. Yes, it came back from the printer today.
C. The print is too small.

questions.exp: A yes/no question; the answer says yes and adds when it came back.
opts: Yes, it came back from the printer today.

script: Which colour should we use for the logo?
C. Navy blue looks the most professional.

questions.exp: 'Which colour' needs a colour: navy blue.
opts: Navy blue looks the most professional.

script: Could you send me the sales figures?
A. The figure is on page two.
C. Sure, I'll e-mail them right now.

questions.exp: A request; the natural reply agrees to e-mail them.
opts: The figure is on page two.
Sure, I'll e-mail them right now.

script: Isn't the product launch next week?
C. No, it was moved to the 20th.

questions.exp: The answer corrects the date. "Lunch is ready" is a sound-alike trap for 'launch'.
opts: No, it was moved to the 20th.

questions.exp: 'Who' asks for a person or company: an agency in Galway.

script: C. I'll order more this afternoon.

questions.exp: A problem is stated; the reply offers to order more.

script: Kevin, have you seen the reviews of our new coffee machine?
Yes, most of them are positive. People love the design.
But several customers say the instructions are hard to follow.
Then let's make a short video showing how to use it. We could post it on our website.
Good idea. I'll ask the design team to start on Monday.

questions.q: What product are the speakers discussing?
questions.exp: 'Our new coffee machine.'

questions.q: What problem do some customers mention?
questions.exp: 'The instructions are hard to follow.'

questions.q: What does the man suggest?
questions.exp: 'Let's make a short video showing how to use it.'

script: Hi Sarah, how many people have registered for the launch event?
About one hundred and twenty so far, which is more than we expected.
The room only holds one hundred. Should we look for a bigger venue?
I already asked the hotel. They can give us the ballroom for the same price.
Perfect. Please update the invitation with the new room name.

questions.q: What is surprising about the event?
questions.exp: 'More than we expected.'

questions.q: What has the hotel offered?
opts: A larger room at the same price
questions.exp: 'The ballroom for the same price.'

questions.q: What does the man ask the woman to do?
questions.exp: 'Please update the invitation with the new room name.'

script: Thank you all for coming to the launch of the Breeze Two air purifier.
Breeze Two is thirty percent quieter than our first model and uses less electricity.
It will be available in shops from the first of December, and online orders open today.
Everyone here tonight will receive a voucher for fifteen percent off. Please collect it at the exit.

questions.q: What is being introduced?
questions.exp: 'The launch of the Breeze Two air purifier.'

questions.q: How is Breeze Two better than the first model?
questions.exp: 'Thirty percent quieter.'

questions.q: What will listeners receive?
opts: A gift card for a shop
questions.exp: 'A voucher for fifteen percent off.'

script: Hi team, a quick update on the online advertising campaign for our new running shoes.
In the first week, our video ads were viewed over eighty thousand times.
However, most sales came from the photo ads on social media, not the videos.
So next week we'll spend more of the budget on photo ads. Please send me any new photos by Wednesday.

questions.q: What is the speaker reporting on?
questions.exp: 'The online advertising campaign.'

questions.q: What led to the most sales?
questions.exp: 'Most sales came from the photo ads.'

questions.q: What does the speaker ask listeners to do?
questions.exp: 'Please send me any new photos by Wednesday.'

questions.q: The launch event was a great ______ thanks to the hard work of the whole team.
questions.exp: A noun after 'a great'.

questions.q: Orders placed after 3 p.m. will be ______ the following business day.
questions.exp: Passive: will be shipped.

questions.q: Our new model is ______ than any other phone in its price range.
questions.exp: Comparative with 'than'.

questions.q: Ms Grant is responsible ______ managing the product launch.
questions.exp: 'Responsible for'.

questions.q: Customers can return the product ______ thirty days if they are not satisfied.
questions.exp: 'Within thirty days' = inside that period.

questions.q: The marketing budget was increased ______ the board's approval.
questions.exp: 'Following' = after.

questions.q: All new staff must ______ a two-day training course.
questions.exp: Base verb after 'must'.

questions.q: The company has ______ expanded into three new European markets.
questions.exp: An adverb before the past participle.

reading.title: Press release
text: DUBLIN — Lumen Lighting today ___1___ its first range of solar-powered garden lamps.
The lamps charge during the day and switch on automatically at night. ___2___
The range will be sold in garden centres across Ireland ___3___ November.
"We wanted to offer customers an easy way to ___4___ their energy bills," said chief executive Orla Fahy.

questions.q: Blank 1
questions.exp: 'Today' with a completed action in a news report: announced.

questions.q: Blank 2
opts: Garden centres are busy in spring.
A full charge provides up to ten hours of light.
questions.exp: This sentence adds detail about how the lamps work.

questions.q: Blank 3
questions.exp: 'From November' = starting in November.

questions.q: Blank 4
questions.exp: 'A way to' + base verb.

texts.title: Chat
body: Liam (9:12): The banners for the launch haven't arrived. The event starts at 11.
Ciara (9:14): I just called the printer. They're sending them by courier — should be there by 10.
Liam (9:15): That works. Can you bring extra tape?
Ciara (9:16): Sure, I'll pick some up on the way.

questions.q: What is the problem?
opts: The banners have not been delivered.
questions.exp: 'The banners ... haven't arrived.'

questions.q: When should the banners arrive?
questions.exp: 'Should be there by 10.'

questions.q: At 9:15, what does Liam mean when he writes 'That works'?
questions.exp: He accepts the new arrangement.

texts.title: ★★★★☆ Breeze Two air purifier
body: I bought the Breeze Two last month and it's much quieter than my old purifier — I can leave it on at night.
The app is easy to use, and I like that it shows the air quality in each room.
My only complaint is the filter: replacements cost €40 and need changing every three months.

questions.q: What does the reviewer like about the product?
opts: The filter lasts a long time.
questions.exp: 'Much quieter than my old purifier.'

questions.q: What does the app show?
questions.exp: 'Shows the air quality in each room.'

questions.q: How much would the reviewer spend on filters in a year?
questions.exp: €40 every three months = four times a year = €160.

texts.title: Staff discount — Breeze Two
body: Employees can buy one Breeze Two at 30% off until 31 December.
Orders must be placed through the staff shop page. Discounts cannot be added after an order is placed.

texts.title: From: Dara Quinn · To: Staff shop · Subject: Discount
body: Hi, I ordered a Breeze Two on the main website yesterday and forgot to use the staff page. Can the 30% discount still be applied? I'd also like to buy a second one for my sister.

questions.q: What is the notice about?
questions.exp: A 30% discount for employees.

questions.q: What mistake did Mr Quinn make?
opts: He did not use the staff shop page.
questions.exp: He ordered on the main website.

questions.q: What will the staff shop most likely tell Mr Quinn?
opts: The discount cannot be added to his order.
questions.exp: 'Discounts cannot be added after an order is placed.'

questions.q: What is true about Mr Quinn's request for a second purifier?
opts: He can buy two at the staff price.
His sister must work for the company.
Only one can be bought at the discount.
questions.exp: 'Employees can buy one Breeze Two at 30% off.'
